names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 12 octombrie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 12 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Πρόβος, Τάραχος και Ανδρόνικος», with the rank word left off; the page's own heading for him is «Αγιος Ταραχος».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 12. октобар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Тарах, Пров и Андроник.“ — Св. is «saint» and not a rank and муч. is the martyr grade this corpus puts in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name, the first of the heading’s three, is the whole of the form; the heading gives none of the three an epithet. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Прова, Тараха и Андроника (304).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the icon standing immediately before this line, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all. The day's other icon of the same kind stands before Cosmas of Maiuma and does not reach this line.

attestations.note: The Russian keeps the three on the same day as the Greek and the Romanian and gives the year neither of them gives, 304. It is the one source that calls him «старый воин», the old soldier, and it gives him the answer for all three: that he sacrifices to the one true God in a pure heart.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 12 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Tarah»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Πρόβος, Τάραχος και Ανδρόνικος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same three men: soldiers taken in the desert by Maxentius the eparch of Tarsus and beheaded in the persecution under Diocletian, with Flavian governor of Cilicia. saint.gr gives the three one page and one life between them and names each of them in its own heading, so this is the folder's own man and not a company to be split again. The page prints no year of death, only «επί Διοκλητιανού (284 - 304 μ.Χ.)», so no `dates` object is proposed. It prints a proper apolytikion and a proper kontakion that name all three, both taken here; its «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» is the common of martyrs «Τῶν Ἁγίωv Μαρτύρωv τὰ κατορθώματα» and its Οἶκος is neither a troparion nor a kontakion, and neither is drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 25.10.2026 (12. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Тарах, Пров и Андроник.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, the first of its three names. The heading is quoted whole, with the closing full stop the Prologue itself prints, which is what BRIEF-SERBIAN section 4 asks for. It had to be measured off the raw cached page, because srbody.mjs and sr-cand.mjs both strip it from their printed output: every heading of this day ends ". " in the source. THE HEADING IS AN ENUMERATED COMPANY OF THREE — Тарах, Пров and Андроник — so section 5 counts three names, three folders are owed a row and the corpus holds all three. The quoted line is the one heading, whole, on all three rows, and the three folders already relate one another. The entry gives each man his own city: Tarachus of Claudiopolis in Syria, Probus of Side in Pamphylia, Andronicus the son of a notable citizen of Ephesus — and the display names all three carry read «of Tarsus», which is where they were tried and is not what this book says they came from. **Nothing is changed on that**: a display name is reserved by section 10, and a reader names a sourced correction rather than making one. `dates` UNTOUCHED ON ALL THREE AND TWO NUMBERS ARE REFUSED. The folders hold `death` 304; this entry dates the trial only «у време цара Диоклецијана», and **an emperor is not a source for a year**. It also says «Тараху беше 65 година у време мучења» — **an age, which is refused and may not be subtracted from a death year to make a birth.** `types` untouched: муч. in the heading is the `martyr` all three hold, and the `soldier` on Tarachus is from another book — this entry does not call him one. No `office`, no `locations`. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND MOST OF IT IS SPEECH AND BEASTS. The proconsul is named **Нумерије Максим**. Tarachus was asked his name three times and three times answered «хришћанин», a Christian. Probus answered the offer of the emperor's honours and the proconsul's friendship with «нити цареве почасти хоћу, нити твоје пријатељство желим» — I want neither the emperor's honours nor your friendship. Andronicus answered the threat of greater torments with «тело моје пред тобом је, чини што хоћеш» — my body is before you, do what you will. In the theatre the beasts would not touch them: **a bear and a fierce lioness fawned on them**, where other condemned men had been torn apart in the same place just before, and many of the crowd believed and shouted against the proconsul, who sent soldiers in to cut the three to pieces with swords. THREE CHRISTIANS WHO BURIED THEM ARE NAMED AND GET NOTHING, WHICH IS RULING 3. The entry calls them Макарије, Феликс and Верије; they came that night, could not tell the martyrs' bodies from the other dead in the dark, prayed, and three candles appeared over the holy bodies. **No folder in this corpus holds any of those three men** — the corpus has six Felixes and many Macarii and not one of them is this one, and nothing read identifies them — so a person the Prologue names but no folder holds gets no folder from a reader. They are here, and not in the prose, and the candles are in the prose without them. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Тарах», which is this folder’s third name form and its first outside Romanian and Greek. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: De isprăvile sfinţilor mucenici Puterile Îngereşti foarte s-au minunat; că fiind un trup muritor, pe vrăjmaşul cel fără de trup cu Puterea Crucii nevoindu-se tare, l-au biruit nevăzut. Şi acum se roagă Domnului să se miluiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Prov, Tarah şi Andronic

english.text: At the deeds of the holy martyrs the angelic Powers marvelled greatly; for being of mortal flesh, and contending mightily by the power of the Cross, they overcame unseen the bodiless enemy. And now they pray the Lord that our souls may be shown mercy.

hymns.text: Ἰσχὺν τὴν ἄμαχον, περιζωσάμενοι, κατεπαλαίσατε, ἐχθρῶν τᾶς φάλαγγας, καὶ ἐδοξάσατε Χριστόν, ἀθλήσεως τοὶς ἀγώσι, Πρόβε παναοίδιμε, ὁ πρόβας πρὸς τὰ κρείττονα, ἔνδοξε Ἀνδρόνικε, Ἐκκλησίας ἐκνίκημα, καὶ Τάραχε πιστῶν ἡ γαλήνη, ὁ τρισαυγὴς Μαρτύρων δῆμος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Τὴν ὡραιότητα — the first hymn on the page the three share, and it names all three of them.

english.text: Girded about with unconquerable strength, you threw down the battalions of the enemy and glorified Christ by the struggles of your contest: Probus all-renowned, who stepped forward to the better things; glorious Andronicus, the Church's victory; and Tarachus, the calm of the faithful — the thrice-shining company of the Martyrs.

hymns.text: Τριάδος ἡμῖv, τὴν δόξαν ἐμφανίσαντες, γενναῖοι Χριστοῦ, ὁπλῖται θεῖοι Μάρτυρες, σὺν Ταράχῳ Πρόβος τε καὶ Ἀνδρόvικος, ἤλεγξαν ἄπασαv, τῶν τυράννων ἀθεότητα, τῇ πίστει γενναίως ἐναθλήσαντες.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν — on the page the three share. It names all three and no other saint.

english.text: You made the glory of the Trinity plain to us, brave soldiers of Christ, divine Martyrs — Probus with Tarachus and Andronicus — and you convicted the whole godlessness of the tyrants, contending bravely in the faith.

hymns.text: Троицы нам славу явиша,/ доблии Христовы оружницы и мученицы,/ с Тарахом Пров же и Андроник:/ обличиша бо все мучителей безбожие,// верою доблественне страдальчествовавше.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников»
source.note: The day prints a troparion of martyrs above it, «Святых мученик исправлением», which names nobody and is the common; this kontakion names all three and is recorded for that reason.

english.text: They made the glory of the Trinity known to us, the valiant men-at-arms and martyrs of Christ, Probus and Andronicus with Tarachus, for they laid bare the whole godlessness of their tormentors, having borne their contest valiantly in faith.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints after the three names, «Мчч. Прова, Тараха и Андроника (304)», and the year its life for the three opens with: «Святые мученики Пров, Тарах и Андроник пострадали за Христа в 304 году в городе Тарсе Киликийском». Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gives a year; both say only that it was the persecution under Diocletian.
